sentences.ar: واحد طلب من جحا يكتب له مكتوب.
sentences.en: Someone asked Juha to write him a letter.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: ما بقدر، إجري بتوجعني.
sentences.en: Juha said: I cannot, my legs hurt.

sentences.ar: قال الرجل: شو دخل إجريك بالكتابة؟
sentences.en: The man said: what do your legs have to do with writing?

sentences.ar: قال جحا: خطي محدا بيقراه غيري.
sentences.en: Juha said: nobody can read my handwriting but me.
So I have to walk to them and read it.
